report.title: {Items.Count} Windows compliance {Plural(Items.Count, 'policy does', 'policies do')} not require BitLocker

messages.businessImpact: An unencrypted laptop that is lost or stolen is a data breach that has to be reported. Compliance is where that becomes enforceable rather than hoped for.
remediation: Enable Require BitLocker in each policy listed.
Confirm an encryption policy is deployed first, or devices will be marked non-compliant before they can encrypt.
messages.cannotSee: Compliance authored in the Settings Catalog is not read, so a BitLocker requirement set in one is invisible here. Whether the estate is encrypted by other means, such as an encryption policy without a compliance rule behind it, is a separate question SEC-001 asks.
